title: Silver disc above the mesa darts away

tellings.quote: straight ahead of us above the mesa and there is literally a silver grayish disc-like object about a hundred feet above the mesa just sitting there suspended in the air
I went from being a skeptic to an experiencer within a matter of minutes.
tellings.difference: Frames it as his first sighting, the one that turned him from skeptic to experiencer, and credits Eric Bard.
tellings.link_reason: Fugal tells the same 2016 sighting, firsthand, of a silver-grey disc hovering above the mesa.

as_told.title: Fugal's first sighting: silver-grey disk above the mesa

as_told.title: Flying saucer 100 ft above the mesa in daylight

plain: In 2016 a silver disc is said to have hung in the air above a mesa on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, and then darted away. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, says he saw it himself. He describes "a silver grayish disc-like object about a hundred feet above the mesa just sitting there suspended in the air." In a later interview he calls it "a flying saucer 100 ft above the mesa in broad daylight, right in front of us," and says he "went from being a skeptic to an experiencer within a matter of minutes." There he names Erik Bard as another witness, and that version does not mention the disc darting away. Both tellings come from Fugal, years apart. If true, the owner of the ranch saw a solid craft in daylight from close up.
